project_type: Vite 6 + React 18 + TanStack Router + Convex (backend) SPA
build_system: Vite 6 with tsc type-checking. Build is `npm run build` which runs `tsc && vite build`.
test_framework: Vitest with @testing-library/react. Tests live alongside code in __tests__ dirs (e.g. src/components/__tests__, src/hooks/__tests__, convex/__tests__).
verification_instructions: 1. `npm run build` must pass (tsc + vite). 2. `npm run test` must pass (58+ tests). 3. `npm run lint` must not add new warnings beyond existing 76.
environment_constraints: Do NOT modify Convex backend schema/functions except deleting one stale comment in convex/stations.ts. All changes are frontend display logic.
contribution_requirements: Single commit: fix: add staleness display, reconcile totals, remove dead controls, fix sparkline scaling (#37, #38, #39, #40). Branch: fix/r1-stale-totals-controls-sparkline.
key_patterns: Components are in src/components/, routes in src/routes/, hooks in src/hooks/, utils in src/utils/. FilterContext (src/lib/FilterContext.tsx) stores global filters with localStorage persistence. Convex API is accessed via hooks wrapping useQuery (e.g. useStations, useStationDetail). AlertLevelBadge accepts alert_level number, -1 renders 'No data' in grey. MicroTrendChart auto-scales y-axis to local min/max currently.
directory_structure: src/components/ (UI components), src/routes/stations/ (index.tsx = list, $id.tsx = detail), src/hooks/ (data hooks), src/lib/ (FilterContext, utils), src/utils/ (timeUtils, haptics, locationUtils), convex/ (backend functions, schema)
